title: Apne Pisar Ke Husn Ka Sadqa Utaarlo
body:
Apne Pisar Ke Husn Ka Sadqa Utaarlo
akbar Abhi Hai Raah Me Laila Pukaarlo
1. Ran Ki Taraf Jo Jaate Hai Humshakle Mustafa
be Aas Hoke Reh Gaye Ab Shah-e-karbala
ro Ro Ke Keh Rahi Hai Yeh Ab Binte Murtaza
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Atthara Saal Paala Tha Jis Noujawan Ko
ruqsat Hussain Karte Hai Us Mehmaan Ko
humnaam-e-murtaza Wo Nabi Ke Nashaan Ko
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Farzand Yeh Tumhara Mere Dil Ka Chain Hai
taskeen-e-qalb Noor-e-nigah-e-hussain Hai
ruqsat Ke Waqt Zainab-e-muztar Ka Bain Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Run Ko Chala Hai Yeh Jo Hai Humshakl-e-mustafa
abbas Se Jalaal Me Jurrat Me Murtaza
madar Hai Laila Baap Hai Sultan-e-karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Sonchi Thi Uska Byaah Rachane Ke Waaste
basti Nayi Nayi Mai Basane Ke Waaste
kya Tum Jiyogi Ashk Bahane Ke Waaste
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Bole Hussain Bete Se Baa'chashme Ashkbaar
beta Hamare Seene Se Lag Jao Aik Baar
tum Jaa Rahe Ho Dil Pa Nahi Mere Eqtiyaar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Zainab Ka Dil Ho Dilbar-e-shaahinshah-e-zaman
attharwin Bahar Hai Shadaab Hai Chaman
bint-e-ali Ke Lab Pe Har Ek Baar Hai Suqan
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Maida'n Ki Simt Jaate Hai Ab Akbar-e-hasee'n
thaame Kaleja Dekhte Hai Unko Shah-e-dee'n
laila Se Roke Kehti Hai Yeh Zainab-e-hazeen
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Thaame Kamar Ko Fatima Zehra Ka Laal Hai
gham Se Ajeeb Madar-e-muztar Ka Haal Hai
mazhar Phupi Ke Lab Pe Faqat Yeh Meqaal Hai
